saria.name: Saria foul water river on the overworld
saria.instructions: Look for the rippling green foul water through Saria. Press Down to enter town.

saria.name: Saria bridge guard before Bagu
saria.instructions: Press Up beside the bridge guard to read his foul water warning.

saria.name: North Saria entrance
saria.instructions: Walk left past the entrance sign to see the first foul water bridge.

saria.name: Saria graveyard bridge
saria.instructions: Cross the bridge in either direction. Watch the foul water and passing villagers' shouts.

items.name: Palace 1 Candle pickup
items.instructions: Walk left to pick up the Candle. Listen for the roar after the fanfare and watch Barba tilt his head up.

items.name: Saria mirror lady
items.instructions: Press Up beside the mirror lady to give her the mirror and see her reaction before she opens the door.

endgame.name: Great Palace elevator
endgame.instructions: Start on the native elevator. Hold Down to descend; Up to return.

endgame.name: Great Palace low tunnel
endgame.instructions: Hold Down in the 32-pixel-high lane. Check that the full head fits and the horizontal pieces stay above the bricks.

endgame.name: Before Thunderbird
endgame.instructions: Check movement, head clearance, combat and HUD.

endgame.name: Before Dark Link
endgame.instructions: Check movement, head clearance, combat and HUD.

endgame.name: Palace 6 boss and crystal approach
endgame.instructions: Jump right across the lava ledges, fight Lava Link, then approach the crystal statue.

endgame.name: Valley of Death rock throwers
endgame.instructions: Walk left toward the Lizalfos on the wall. Face it, jump and press Up+B as it leans out to throw.

endgame.name: East Hyrule grass encounter
endgame.instructions: Walk right while firing, then turn back before the room exit. Watch for steady ground scroll and intact clouds, then pause to see the clouds drift right.

bosses.name: Horsehead (Palace 1)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

bosses.name: Helmethead (Palace 2)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

bosses.name: Rebonack (Palace 3)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

bosses.name: Carock (Palace 4)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Try three Attack 7 fireball hits or cast Reflect, face Carock and crouch to return his bolts. Reload this key to try the other route.

bosses.name: Gooma (Palace 5)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

bosses.name: Lava Link (Palace 6)
bosses.instructions: Jump right over the lava ledges and keep holding Right. Barba roars on landing, then holds still for half a second before Lava Link rises.

bosses.name: Thunderbird (Great Palace)
bosses.instructions: Walk right to start the fight. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

bosses.name: Dark Link (Great Palace)
bosses.instructions: Starts the moment the intro ends: the shadow dragon is already beside you. Reload this key to retry with full meters.

world.name: Rauru street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Ruto street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Saria street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Mido street
world.instructions: Find the knight and talk to him for the first downstab lesson.

world.name: Nabooru street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Darunia street
world.instructions: Find the knight and talk to him for the first upstab lesson.

world.name: New Kasuto street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Old Kasuto street
world.instructions: Check outdoor NPCs, doorways, palette and head clearance.

world.name: Death Mountain entrance
world.instructions: Walk the native overworld; enter nearby caves or Palace 4.

world.name: Maze Island near Palace 4
world.instructions: Walk the native overworld; enter nearby caves or Palace 4.

gem.name: Palace 6 gem placement
gem.instructions: Walk right to the crystal statue. Watch the floor pulse and the raised stonework light up during Barba's victory roar. Reload F1 to repeat.

busy.name: Palace 5 two-Mago room
busy.instructions: Jump and alternate upstab and downstab while both Magos are active. Let a shot hit you and watch for a red duplicate.

busy.name: Palace 5 Mago and statue hall
busy.instructions: Fight through the statue hall while the Mago teleports and fires.

busy.name: Palace 5 first Mago room
busy.instructions: Let the Mago appear and fire, then try both aerial stabs during its next teleport.

busy.name: Palace 5 before Gooma
busy.instructions: Turn and breathe in both directions with the Ironknuckles on screen.

busy.name: Palace 2 crowded floor corridor
busy.instructions: Jump and fire volleys through the crowded corridor. Watch the HUD and the enemies around Barba.

busy.name: Palace 3 Ironknuckles and breakable blocks
busy.instructions: Walk right and breathe into the breakable blocks with the Ironknuckles nearby.

busy.name: Palace 6 Wizzrobe hall
busy.instructions: Fight the Wizzrobe while other enemies and shots are on screen.

busy.name: Palace 1 before Horsehead
busy.instructions: Walk and fire toward the enemy groups in the approach corridor.

busy.name: Old Kasuto monster street
busy.instructions: Turn and breathe through the Moas. Watch the HUD and let a Moa hit you in midair.

busy.name: Rauru street crowd
busy.instructions: Breathe through the crowd and watch the sprites during panic, shouts and scorch effects.

movement.name: Palace 6 lava ledge
movement.instructions: Walk onto lava, jump back, check native body and folded head.

movement.name: Palace 1 low tunnel
movement.instructions: Crouch immediately and watch where the horizontal pieces meet the brick floor.

movement.name: Palace 1 elevator shaft
movement.instructions: Start on the native elevator. Hold Down to descend; Up to return.

movement.name: West Hyrule water bridge
movement.instructions: Walk left and compare cloud motion with the bridge. Watch the water shimmer below the deck.

movement.name: Medicine cave collapsing bridge
movement.instructions: Cross the collapsing bridge and watch the liquid shimmer against the stationary cave walls.

movement.name: Palace 6 drop-shaft edge
movement.instructions: Stand safely at the gap; jump across or fall to the lower room. This is not a lethal bottomless pit.

movement.name: Palace 2 breakable blocks
movement.instructions: Turn left and shoot through the 2x3 breakable block wall with the Glove.

movement.name: West Hyrule Myu cave
movement.instructions: Let the little Myu crawl through both frames. Crouch nearby and check that both sprites look right.

movement.name: West Hyrule grass encounter
movement.instructions: Stand still to watch the sprig tips sway. Walk in either direction to see the clouds move more slowly than the ground.

spells.name: Palace 2 Green Palace (menu, Barrel, Blade)
spells.instructions: Press Enter to inspect the 2-column spell window over Green Palace bricks, or press Space to roll a BARREL down the crowded corridor (also try BLADE, STAR, or METEOR).

spells.name: Palace 3 Ironknuckles (Heavy, Axe, Decoy)
spells.instructions: Press Space for HEAVY (2x damage + shield bypass) against the Ironknuckles, or switch to AXE, DECOY, or BLADE to clear the breakable blocks.

spells.name: Palace 6 lava ledge (Wyrmlng, Jump)
spells.instructions: Press Space for WYRMLNG to fly across the lava, or try JUMP to leap the wide lava gap.

spells.name: Palace 5 two-Mago room (Clock, Lock)
spells.instructions: Press Space for CLOCK to freeze both teleporting Magos in place, or switch to LOCK for homing fireballs.

spells.name: Carock boss room (Reflect, Scales)
spells.instructions: Press Space for REFLECT and walk right to bounce Carock's bolts back, or try SCALES / HEAVY.

spells.name: Palace 6 Wizzrobe hall (Lock, Double)
spells.instructions: Press Space for LOCK to track the phasing Wizzrobe, or cast DOUBLE for 2x XP on high-value Palace 6 enemies.

spells.name: Old Kasuto Moa street (Inferno, Star, Lucky)
spells.instructions: Press Space for INFERNO to clear the swarming Moas, or try STAR (touch-kill), AXE, DOUBLE, or LUCKY for forced drops.

spells.name: Palace 1 low-HP approach (Life, Scales, Lucky)
spells.instructions: Starts at low health: press Space for LIFE to heal, or test SCALES and LUCKY against the enemies ahead.

spells.name: Great Palace Thunderbird (Meteor, Spell, Inferno)
spells.instructions: Press Space for METEOR and walk right to fight Thunderbird, or test INFERNO, AXE, and SPELL in the Great Palace.

spells.name: Rauru town street (Decoy, Spell, Jump)
spells.instructions: Press Space for DECOY in town, jump onto rooftops with JUMP, or test SPELL, METEOR, and INFERNO around fleeing villagers.

fireballs.name: West Hyrule dark grotto (no Candle)
fireballs.instructions: Pitch-black cave without the Candle. Fire volleys to test fireball glow halos, firelight palette flicker, and range across the collapsing bridge.

fireballs.name: West Hyrule Myu cave
fireballs.instructions: Lit cave with low Myu enemies. Test crouching fireballs, METEOR floor waves, and BLADE / LOCK in a tight cave.

fireballs.name: West Hyrule water bridge (long open ledge)
fireballs.instructions: Wide-open bridge over water. Test full 124 px horizontal fireball range, 5-shot volley cadence, and Up+B upward shots.

fireballs.name: Palace 6 lava ledge (big gap)
fireballs.instructions: Big open ledge over lava. Test long-range fireballs across the gap, jumping shots, and BLADE 8-way steering.

fireballs.name: Palace 6 drop-shaft high ledge
fireballs.instructions: High ledge overlooking a deep drop. Test long fireball trajectories from height and firing while falling.

fireballs.name: Valley of Death wall ledges
fireballs.instructions: Elevated wall ledges with Rock Lizalfos. Test Up+B upward-angled fireballs and LOCK homing shots against high perches.

fireballs.name: Palace 3 Ironknuckles and breakable blocks
fireballs.instructions: Test Glove block-breaking with fireballs, Ironknuckle shield rebound physics, and HEAVY / AXE.

fireballs.name: Palace 1 low tunnel
fireballs.instructions: Low 32 px ceiling. Test crouched vs. tucked-head fireball mouth height and range under stone.

fireballs.name: Palace 2 crowded corridor
fireballs.instructions: Busy corridor with multiple enemies. Test 5-shot volley load governor and multi-target fireball hits.

fireballs.name: Great Palace approach
fireballs.instructions: Long Great Palace corridor. Test full volleys, INFERNO, METEOR, and HEAVY against late-game enemies.

ngplus.name: West Hyrule NG+ overworld
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) in West Hyrule with all 18 spells and both thrusts. Walk to any Mountain tile and press B to melt it into Desert.

ngplus.name: Death Mountain NG+ (with Flute)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) with Flute ($0789=1). Face a Mountain tile and press B to verify mountain melting works even while carrying the Flute.

ngplus.name: Maze Island NG+ overworld
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) on Maze Island. Test overworld mountain melting and East Hyrule routing.

ngplus.name: Rauru town street (NG+)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) in Rauru with all 18 spells and both thrusts. Test townsfolk, fireballs, and spell menu.

ngplus.name: Palace 1 entrance (NG+)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) at Palace 1 entrance with carried-over spells, levels, and techniques.

ngplus.name: Palace 6 lava ledge (NG+)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) at Palace 6 lava ledge. Test lava traversal, fireballs, and WYRMLNG.

ngplus.name: Before Lava Link (NG+)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) before Lava Link. Jump right across the lava to trigger the boss fight.

ngplus.name: Before Dark Barba (NG+)
ngplus.instructions: NG+ ($07A0=1) before Dark Barba in the Great Palace. Defeat Dark Barba to test the NG+ ending loop.
